name: Kon'yaku Haki Sareta Goreijou wa, Kyou mo Ouji o Tou no Ue kara Tsukiotosu
original_name: 婚約破棄されたご令嬢は、今日も王子を塔の上から突き落とす
source:
A noble countess just got called off her engagement, and nothing could have made her happier! She just wants to live surrounded by the books she adores so much but... certain men start to approach her! It seems like she won't be able to escape from love's grasp that easily...

The otome game adaptation of a popular Internet novel.
